24.old: Condos are strata-titled under the BC Strata Property Act. Request Form B, the last two years of strata minutes, the depreciation report and the bylaws (rentals, pets and age restrictions) before removing subjects; 55+ and 45+ complexes enforce age bylaws that apply to at least one occupant.
24.new: Sardis condos are strata lots, and the BC Strata Property Act covers them. Subjects shouldn't come off until you have the Form B, two years of strata minutes and the depreciation report, along with the bylaws about pets, rentals and age restrictions. Age bylaws get enforced in 55+ and 45+ complexes, where at least one occupant has to qualify.

26.old: Floodplain: parts of Fairfield Island, Greendale, Rosedale, Yarrow and lower Sardis lie in the Fraser and Vedder River floodplain, protected by the City's dike network. Ask for the property's flood construction level, lender and insurer requirements, and whether a geotechnical or floodplain covenant is registered on title.
26.new: Each of Lower Sardis, Rosedale, Yarrow, Greendale and Fairfield Island has land in the floodplain of both the Fraser River and the Vedder River, with protection coming from the City's dike network. Before buying, ask what the flood construction level is, what the lender and the insurer will require, and whether title carries a registered geotechnical or floodplain covenant.

Graham Middle-Secondary, Chilliwack Secondary and a range of elementary catchments including Unsworth, Watson and Vedder. Always confirm catchment with SD33 before buying. 28.new: Schools and transit: Chilliwack is in School District 33 (SD33), with catchments for Sardis Secondary, Chilliwack Secondary and G.W. Graham Middle-Secondary, as well as for elementary zones such as Unsworth, Watson and Vedder. Do check the exact catchment with SD33 prior to buying. 43.new: Under School District 33 (SD33), Chilliwack Secondary serves the north side. G.W. Graham and Sardis Secondary are the schools for Sardis and the south side. Catchments change, so for any specific address, check with SD33.

45.new: Yes. In Chilliwack, BC Transit buses operate locally on Vedder Road and Young Road as well as Luckakuck Way, and you can get to Abbotsford and Langley on the Fraser Valley Express. Bus service is minimal or absent in rural Greendale, Columbia Valley and Ryder Lake.
